name: Frying pan
definition: Shallow, flat-bottomed pan with sloped sides and a long handle, for frying and searing.

name: Wok
definition: deep, round-bottomed or flat-bottomed pan with high flaring sides, for stir-frying.

name: Grill pan
definition: pan with a ridged or flat cooking plate, for grilling or searing on a hob.

name: Sauté pan
definition: Wide pan with straight or high sides and usually a lid, for frying, braising and reducing.

name: Saucepan
definition: deep round pot with one long handle, for boiling and making sauces.

name: Stockpot
definition: tall, large pot with two handles, for stock, soup and boiling in quantity.

name: Dutch oven
definition: heavy lidded pot, often cast iron, for braising and slow cooking on the hob or in the oven.

name: Pressure cooker
definition: Sealed pot that cooks under steam pressure; stovetop and electric versions exist.

name: Roasting pan
definition: deep, open oven pan for roasting meat and vegetables.

name: Baking tray
definition: flat oven sheet with low or no rim, for baking.

name: Gastronorm pan
definition: Container made to the gastronorm size standard, used in commercial kitchens and serving counters.

name: Air fryer
definition: countertop appliance that cooks food in a basket by circulating hot air.

name: Toaster
definition: appliance that browns slices of bread with radiant elements.

name: Oven
definition: enclosed cooking appliance that bakes and roasts by heating the air in a chamber.

name: Hob
definition: cooking surface of burners or heating zones on which pans are set.

name: Barbecue grill
definition: Grill that cooks food over a fire, charcoal, gas or electric heat.

name: Rice cooker
definition: Appliance that cooks rice in an inner pot under automatic control. Heating type ranges from conventional to micom, induction and pressure induction.

name: Bain-marie
definition: Heated water bath that keeps food warm or cooks it gently, used in commercial kitchens.

name: Cookware set
definition: Set of pots and pans of one maker line, sold and rated as one product.

name: Chef's knife
definition: general-purpose kitchen knife with a broad, curved blade for chopping, slicing and mincing.

name: Santoku
definition: Japanese general-purpose knife with a flat edge and a sheep's-foot tip.

name: Nakiri
definition: Japanese vegetable knife with a straight, rectangular blade.

name: Paring knife
definition: small knife with a short blade for peeling and fine work in the hand.

name: Kitchen utility knife
definition: Mid-size kitchen knife between the paring knife and the chef's knife (not the workshop utility knife, which is in Tools & Workshop Equipment).

name: Bread knife
definition: long knife with a serrated edge for cutting bread.

name: Boning knife
definition: narrow, flexible or stiff knife for taking meat and fish off the bone.

name: Slicing knife
definition: long, narrow knife for slicing cooked meat and raw fish.

name: Cleaver
definition: heavy, broad, rectangular blade for chopping through bone or, in the Chinese form, for all-purpose cutting.

name: Deba
definition: Thick, single-bevel Japanese knife for butchering fish.

name: Yanagiba
definition: Long, single-bevel Japanese knife for slicing raw fish.

name: Usuba
definition: Thin, single-bevel Japanese vegetable knife with a straight edge.

name: Cutting board
definition: board of wood, plastic or composite to cut food on.

name: Knife sharpener
definition: stone, rod or device that sharpens or hones a kitchen knife's edge.

name: Grater
definition: hand tool with a surface of sharp-edged holes for shredding food.

name: Colander
definition: perforated or mesh bowl for draining or sieving food.

name: Spatula
definition: hand tool with a flat, broad blade for turning, lifting or scraping food.

name: Pepper mill
definition: Hand mill that grinds pepper or spices. A grinder for coffee is under Coffee, tea & water.

name: Kitchen scale
definition: Scale for weighing ingredients; some connect to an app.

name: Kitchen thermometer
definition: thermometer for the temperature of food, oil or an oven.

name: Kitchen timer
definition: timer that signals when a set cooking time has passed.

name: Stand mixer
definition: countertop mixer with a bowl and a head that drives beaters, whisk or dough hook.

name: Food processor
definition: appliance with a bowl and interchangeable blades and discs for chopping, slicing and mixing.

name: Refrigerator
definition: Insulated, powered cabinet that keeps food and drink cold; built-in or freestanding.

name: Wine fridge
definition: refrigerated cabinet made to keep wine at storage or serving temperature.

name: Food storage container
definition: lidded container for keeping food.

name: Lunch bag
definition: Insulated bag for carrying a meal and keeping it cool.

name: Drink bottle
definition: Reusable bottle for carrying a drink, sport or not.

name: Hydration bladder
definition: Flexible drink reservoir with a drinking tube, sold on its own.

name: Dinner plate
definition: Large flat plate on which a main meal is served and eaten; a commemorative or display plate is also listed here.

name: Table fork
definition: Fork laid at the place setting for eating.

name: Table spoon
definition: Spoon laid at the place setting for eating.

name: Table knife
definition: Knife laid at the place setting for eating.

name: Steak knife
definition: Sharp, often serrated table knife for cutting meat at the plate.

name: Butter knife
definition: Blunt table knife for spreading butter.

name: Wine glass
definition: glass with a bowl shaped for drinking wine, stemmed or stemless.

name: Tumbler
definition: flat-bottomed glass without a stem.

name: Decanter
definition: glass vessel into which wine or spirits are poured to serve.

name: Mug
definition: large cup with a handle, used without a saucer.

name: Teacup
definition: Handled cup for tea or coffee, usually used with a saucer; a cup and saucer sold together is listed here.

name: Saucer
definition: small shallow dish on which a cup stands.

name: Serving tray
definition: Tray made to carry and serve food and drink.

name: Hard placemat
definition: Rigid mat set under a place setting; a textile placemat is in Soft Furnishings.

name: Coaster
definition: Small hard mat set under a glass or cup.

name: Semi-automatic espresso machine
definition: espresso machine with a pump in which the user grinds, doses, tamps and starts and stops the shot.

name: Super-automatic espresso machine
definition: espresso machine with a built-in grinder that grinds, doses, tamps and brews at one touch.

name: Manual lever espresso machine
definition: espresso machine in which a hand lever drives the water through the coffee.

name: Drip coffee maker
definition: machine that drips hot water over ground coffee in a filter into a carafe.

name: Moka pot
definition: stovetop pot that pushes boiling water by steam pressure up through ground coffee.

name: Coffee grinder
definition: Burr or blade grinder made for coffee beans, by hand or electric.

name: Teapot
definition: Lidded vessel with a spout and handle for brewing and pouring tea; Yixing teapots are included.

name: Kyusu
definition: Japanese teapot with a side handle.

name: Gaiwan
definition: Lidded bowl on a saucer for brewing tea.

name: Kettle
definition: Vessel that boils water, on the stove or electric; the Japanese iron tetsubin is included.

name: Water filter jug
definition: Jug with a filter cartridge that treats water for drinking; replacement cartridges are in Climate, Water & Energy.

name: Cocktail shaker
definition: closed vessel in which a cocktail is shaken with ice.

name: Jigger
definition: double-ended measure for spirits.

name: Dishwasher
definition: appliance that washes and dries dishes, cookware and cutlery.

name: Dish rack
definition: Rack on which washed dishes stand to drain and dry.

name: Oven glove
definition: insulated glove or mitt for handling hot cookware.

name: Apron
definition: garment worn over clothes to protect them while cooking.

name: Vending machine
definition: machine that dispenses food or drink on payment.

name: Countertop oven
definition: small plug-in oven that stands on the worktop, for toasting, baking, roasting and air frying

name: Food steamer
definition: basket or tiered vessel set over boiling water to cook food in steam; bamboo steamer is a named form

name: Kitchen shears
definition: scissors made to cut food, herbs and poultry in the kitchen

name: French press
definition: coffee maker that steeps ground coffee in hot water and presses it out with a plunger mesh filter

name: Portafilter
definition: handled filter holder made for one espresso machine, locked into its group head

name: Coffee machine water tank
definition: replacement water reservoir made for one coffee machine model

name: Blender jar
definition: jar, lid or blade assembly made for one blender family

name: Deep fryer
definition: appliance that cooks food immersed in hot oil in a thermostatic tank or basket

name: Microwave oven
definition: enclosed appliance that heats food with microwaves; combination microwave ovens included

name: Blender
definition: appliance with a jar and fast spinning blade that purees, blends and crushes food and drink

name: Ladle
definition: deep-bowled long-handled spoon for serving and pouring soup, sauce and liquid

name: Cooking spoon
definition: Long-handled spoon for stirring and serving in cooking, solid or slotted. Spoons for eating are under Tableware & serveware.

name: Pocket scale
definition: small portable scale for weighing small amounts (K-167).
